loginScreen.title: Sign In
loginScreen.errorLoginMessage: The email or password is incorrect. Please check your information.

howToUseScreen.title: How To Use
howToUseScreen.newText1: Fill in your information in the required fields
howToUseScreen.newText3: Hold your phone close to your Express Tap card
howToUseScreen.newText4: Your information will be successfully saved to the card
howToUseScreen.editText1: Tap the Edit button for the card you want to update
howToUseScreen.editText2: Hold your phone close to your Express Tap card
howToUseScreen.editText3: On the screen that opens, delete or change the desired information
howToUseScreen.editText5: Hold your card again; the updated information will be saved
howToUseScreen.deleteText2: Hold your Express Tap card close to your phone
howToUseScreen.deleteText3: All information on the card will be permanently deleted
howToUseScreen.databaseText1: In this menu, you can view all employees in your company who have been issued an Express Tap card
howToUseScreen.databaseText2: You can also see the date each card was created/issued
howToUseScreen.wifiText3: Hold your phone close to any Express Tap card
howToUseScreen.wifiText4: Later, other devices can simply scan this card to automatically connect to the Wi-Fi network
